problematicWording.ru: Ограда развалена, вещи разбросаны, товарищи исчезли. Он зовёт их и стреляет, но ответа нет.
problematicWording.en: The hedge is wrecked, belongings scattered, his companions gone. He calls and fires, but no answer comes.

requiredFindings.effectOnMeaning: Changes the physical evidence of the disappearance and adds an unrecorded shot by Malone. In the primary scene the enclosure is as he left it, except that its gate is open. The lone shot occurred before his arrival; the empty cartridge belongs to Roxton, whose capture account explains it. This is a concrete alteration of the mystery scene, not a prose preference.

anchors: And suddenly there came something to remind me of my absent companions.
The zareba rose before me, even as I had left it, but the gate was open.
one of them--Lord John's--had the empty cartridge in the breech.
I shot one of them through the belly

smallestSourceSupportedCorrection.ru: Заменить разрушенную ограду на открытый вход: «Вход в ограду открыт, вещи разбросаны, товарищи исчезли». Удалить «и стреляет», оставив безответные крики.
smallestSourceSupportedCorrection.en: Change the wrecked hedge to an open gate: “The gate stands open, belongings are scattered, his companions are gone.” Remove “and fires”; retain his unanswered calls.

readerJudgment.story: The repaired corpus is an engaging, recognisable adventure rather than a lesson series. Gladys’s ambition, Challenger’s swagger, Summerlee’s resistance, Roxton’s action, exploration, fear, violent alliance and comic/romantic/material endings survive.
readerJudgment.routes: Essential/Core coherently stop at the missing companions; they are declared shorter routes rather than failed full-book summaries. Deep carries rescue, war, escape and all London resolutions.
readerJudgment.parity: No material RU/EN reversal found; the required source error is shared by both languages.
readerJudgment.authorReflections: Malone’s unease over conquest is supported in XIV and is not rejected as editorial moralising. No exercise or management lesson found.
readerJudgment.uncertainty: Later pterodactyl fate remains uncertain. Fictional animals/geography are read as the novel’s world, not empirical assertions.
